units: metres; size is the mesh bounding box in Unity axes [x, y, z]
front: every part faces Blender +Y (Unity forward once the FBX root is turned 180 deg, as for the props)
colour: vertex colour 'Col' (bytes = authored values): rgb; alpha = tint mask, 1 = tinted by the game (albedo = rgb * lerp(1, tint, alpha)), 0 = fixed detail colour. Skin on Head/Hand_Mitten is tintable.

sockets.torso: Torso pivot at y 0.78 (mesh y -0.55..+0.40 around it, top stays under the head)
sockets.head: Head pivot at y 1.42 (no eyeballs: the game keeps its eye spheres at (+-0.1, 0.07, 0.2))
sockets.hand: origin = palm centre, fingers forward, thumb up, symmetric: same mesh for HandL/HandR
sockets.foot: origin = bottom-centre of the sole (on the ground), toe forward

notes: Hair_Bald not made: a bald Goob is simply a Head without hair.
